title: Oracle-Free Retrieval and Selective Scientific-Claim Verification: A Reproducible SciFact Development-Set Audit
description: Exploratory, oracle-free SciFact development-set audit of 300 claims and 5,183 abstracts. BM25 top-1 evidence retrieval reached 133/188 (70.74%) and top-10 176/188 (93.62%). Three-class accuracy was 195/300 (65.00%). A predefined selective filter accepted 122/300 claims; 94/122 (77.05%) were correct and 28 incorrect. Contradiction recall declined from 33/64 to 17/64 under abstention. Invalid input-order negative control retained. This preprint is not peer reviewed, externally validated, or suitable for clinical decision-making.
